title: Merge a PR on its lane lint pass; main's run is the check
why:
[18:21 CST Nov 15, triage] Owner words (relayed, verbatim as the consultant relayed them): "B for sure", answering the consultant's 18:20 CST question. Ruling own-merge-on-lint-pass (supersedes the git-never-merge-failing-ci sentence; the red-main revert part stays). Old rule governs until the merge tool and CLAUDE.md change on main. Addendum (coordinator 18:22 CST, relayed): the change also touches decision roles-each-layer-proves-once ("The PR run is the merge check"); the records to rewrite are the consultant's PR's to name; until its merge-tool PR lands the tool still requires a green run, so nothing changes for runner 10. Same direction as waiting-page item 902 (ready-gate-scope), a different gate; item 902 stays open. (source: consultant 18:22 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not owner-typed here)

[18:33 CST Nov 15, triage] The consultant's PR is #3562 (REST not read by triage; relayed), for ruling own-merge-on-lint-pass. (source: consultant 18:33 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not read by triage as typed)

[18:48 CST Nov 15, triage] PR #3562 is built at head bccc415865; its test comments are being fixed. It is blocked on GitHub branch protection on main, which requires all-jobs-passed and blocks a merge while that check is pending (main's ruleset, decision main-branch-protection ruling r). The consultant brought the owner options a/b/c; its pick is a: untick the required check. That is a change to the ruleset, NOT covered by the Nov 11 grant (the grant names the ruleset set up then, not removing the check): recorded as the owner's call, NOT done. (source: consultant 18:48 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not read by triage; not owner-typed)

[19:08 CST Nov 15, triage] The blocker is removed by the owner at 19:08 CST (relayed; ruling own-all-jobs-passed-removed): the owner took the consultant's pick a himself, on GitHub. Not done by any session here. Stale records for the consultant to rewrite: the "Acts the cloud refuses" bullet in .claude/CLAUDE.md and decision main-branch-protection. (source: consultant 19:08 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not read as typed)

[19:15 CST Nov 15, triage] Coordinator's REST read of 19:15 CST Nov 15 (relayed, not read by triage): main's required_status_checks are empty, enforcement is off, and rulesets are []. The owner's words as the coordinator quotes them, trailing words cut by the coordinator: "all jobs passed has been removed as a status requirement (also give me the bash to turn this off on all my repos ...)". The bash for all his repos is the consultant's, given in chat; no page task. (source: coordinator 19:15 CST, relayed by triage; REST not read by triage)

[19:19 CST Nov 15, triage] Since the owner removed all-jobs-passed as a required check (ruling own-all-jobs-passed-removed), the merge tool refuses every merge: "main has no branch protection and no ruleset that requires checks" (verbatim from runner 10's #3545 attempt at 19:18 CST). load_config (merge/merge.py:2533) reads stamp.json from origin/main; the pin PR #3564 (Pin merge.requiredChecks to all-jobs-passed; head 35c6d750f3, draft, only .github/stamp.json, a stale test being re-pointed) cannot land through the tool; the consultant asked the owner at 19:19 CST to merge #3564 himself in the GitHub web page once its run is green. Effect: no merge lands, page PRs included, until #3564 is on main. Debt draft merge-tool-needs-protection-or-pin in roadmap/outbox/triage.md; step merge-pin-required-checks. (source: coordinator 19:20 CST, relaying runner 10's refusal text (read by the coordinator, not triage); relayed by triage; not owner-typed)

[19:20 CST Nov 15, triage] Stale-record rewrite (consultant 19:20 CST, relayed, not read by triage): draft PR #3565 (branch protection-no-required-check, head 161ac2100d); it changes .claude/CLAUDE.md, decision main-branch-protection ruling r, same-check-kinds, and the ci-hygiene and project-ops skills. Consultant's reading: only the status check was removed; the delete and force-push blocks stay. The merge-tool fix is #3564 (pin requiredChecks), which needs the owner's web-page merge because the tool reads stamp.json from main. Known follow-up (consultant): protect.py still sets all-jobs-passed as required, so running it would put the check back (debt draft protect-py-restores-required-check). (source: consultant 19:20 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not read by triage; not owner-typed)
